description: Discover Dayze MCP tools outside the core default expert listing. Returns matching opt-in tools with their toolset and how to enable them (URL ?toolsets=, tools/list params, or tools.* connection scopes). Call with no query to list available toolsets. Core everyday tools are already listed; this does not replace tools/list. ($0.00)

include_core.description: When true, also return matches from the default core set. Default false.

query.description: Case-insensitive match against tool name, title or description. Empty lists toolsets.

toolset.description: Limit to one opt-in pack id (inventory, finance, crm, …) or "all" for every extra.

name: search_tools

enable_all.description: How to restore the full expert catalog for this connection.

items.description: A matching tool with its toolset and enable hints.
An opt-in expert toolset and how to enable it.

title: Search MCP Tools
